name: chat-coss

frames.best_why: Header, reaction chips, a sent message and the quoted reply are all visible together in a full thread.

tagline: Rounded chat thread with reactions, quoted replies and a typing indicator.
summary: A dark group chat panel: an avatar stack header, a date pill and unread divider, incoming and outgoing bubbles with emoji reaction chips, quoted reply references, delivery ticks and a typing line above the composer.
appearance: A tall dark panel with a header of overlapping avatars and the group name. Inside, short rounded grey bubbles sit left with tiny avatars and names, and right in a slightly lighter fill, with emoji chips underneath and a quoted block above one message. A rounded composer with a circular send button closes the bottom.
behaviour: Sending appends a right-aligned bubble whose small clock turns into a tick, and the thread scrolls to it. A New divider marks unseen messages, a Priya is typing line with dots sits before the composer, and reaction chips toggle on click.
demo_content: Launch crew thread with Priya, Daniel and Sofia discussing release notes for 4.2 and a post going live.
search_phrases: quoted reply in a message bubble
use_when: You need a group conversation with replies, reactions and read state assembled from separate parts.
avoid_when: A single support chatbot bubble: this is a full multi-person thread with composer, far heavier than needed.
customise: Parts take content through props and children: bubble side and grouping, reaction chips, delivery status, replies and typing labels; layout and theme come from classes.
weight_why: Several spring animations for bubbles and reactions plus a scrolling log; no continuous loop.

a11y.note: The log is labelled and live, controls have aria labels and reduced motion is honoured; reactions remain pointer first.

issues: Reaction counts and timestamps are very small and low contrast on the dark bubbles.
polish_why: Polished group chat with believable details; tiny metadata text is the only weak point.
